name: com.cryptpass.app
description: A sample Apache Cordova application that responds to the deviceready event.

scripts.test-android: npm run cryptpass:build && npm run locales:build && tsc && cordova run android
scripts.test-android-device: npm run cryptpass:build && npm run locales:build && tsc && cordova run android --device
scripts.test-electron: npm run electron-compile && cordova run electron
scripts.build-electron: npm run electron-compile && cordova build electron --release
scripts.build-android: npm run cryptpass:build && npm run locales:build && tsc && cordova build android --release
scripts.electron-compile: npm run cryptpass:build && npm run locales:build && tsc
scripts.cryptpass:build: npm run build --prefix node_modules/cryptpass && npm run bundle --prefix node_modules/cryptpass && node scripts/copy-cryptpass-bundle.js

author: Apache Cordova Team
